details:
A web interface where all NASA missions are shown and explained, specially the forgotten ones, in order to demonstrate that an unsuccessful mission that seems irrellevant is not, since there's something to learn from that. The interface's objective is to show what can be learnt from them.

The interface uses a static website using HTML, CSS and JS.

In oder to publicate the website, GitHub was used in order to get a free domain

(All images were extracted from the open-source NASA photo gallery and information. All the information was extracted from the open-source NASA information documents and from the NASA SpaceApp Challenge given information)
